description: The formula of an atomic pattern \(p\) holds on a tuple precisely when the tuple has pattern \(p\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.atomicPatternFormula_realize.{u} {o : Bool} {n : ℕ}
  {M : Type u} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).Structure M]
  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Atom o n → Bool) (x : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.atomicPatternFormula p).Realize Empty.elim x ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.pattern
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Shared.relation x =
      p
